description:
Sends a notification.test event to the receiver at once, signed like a delivery, and answers what came back. It is not queued, not retried and does not change the webhook's state; it can be sent to a disabled webhook that has a URL. A request that fails is answered 200 with ok false and the reason in error.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch) At most 5 test mails and webhook tests a minute per address, one test of a webhook at a time (429).
